title: "API"
toc: true
toc-depth: 4
---

Convenience functions (`scatter`, `arcs`, `lines`, `paths`, `polygons`, `text`,
`hexbin`, `heatmap`, `geojson`) are public but **not exported**, because their names
collide with Plots.jl and Makie.jl. Call them qualified, e.g. `DeckGL.scatter(...)`.

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
using DeckGL
```

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
# Convenience functions are public but unexported, so list them alongside the exports
const UNEXPORTED = [:scatter, :arcs, :lines, :paths, :polygons, :text, :hexbin, :heatmap, :geojson]
export_names = sort(unique([filter(!=(:DeckGL), names(DeckGL)); UNEXPORTED]))

classify(b) = b isa Type ? :type : b isa Function ? :function : :constant

# Docstring section headings ("# Arguments") would render as page-level <h1>.
# Bold them instead, leaving code fences alone.
function flatten_headings(doc)
    fenced = false
    io = IOBuffer()
    for line in eachline(IOBuffer(doc))
        startswith(line, "```") && (fenced = !fenced)
        m = fenced ? nothing : match(r"^#+ +(.*)$", line)
        println(io, isnothing(m) ? line : "**$(m[1])**")
    end
    return String(take!(io))
end

for (kind, label) in [(:type, "Types"), (:function, "Functions"), (:constant, "Constants")]
    items = filter(n -> classify(getfield(DeckGL, n)) == kind, export_names)
    isempty(items) && continue
    println("## $label\n")
    for name in items
        binding = getfield(DeckGL, name)
        doc = flatten_headings(string(Docs.doc(binding)))
        println("""
        ### `$name` {#$(lowercase(string(name))) .api-item}

        ::: {.card .mb-3}
        ::: {.card-body}
        $doc
        :::
        :::
        """)
    end
end
```
